text:
lee: Need a tiny docs note for v1->v2: how to handle model-alias swaps when embedding dims change. Keep it short: one para, TS + Py examples, curl smoke test, and a support template. Who can draft?

tara: I can. Plan: show a guard that checks embedding dim before indexing and fallback to v1 encoding if mismatch.

tara: Py snippet:
```py
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
emb = c.embed(model='redwood-v2', input='doc')
if len(emb) != 1536:
    # fallback to v1 encoding to keep index consistent
    emb = c.embed(model='redwood-v1', input='doc')
```

tara: TS snippet:
```ts
import { Client } from '@redwood/inference'
const c = new Client()
const emb = await c.embed({model:'redwood-v2', input:'doc'})
if (emb.length !== 1536) {
  // use v1 encoding to avoid retrieval regressions
  emb = await c.embed({model:'redwood-v1', input:'doc'})
}
```

mike: docs-ci: lint ok. Suggest adding a curl check example and a one-line support ticket template.

lee: Support template: "Observed embedding-dim fallback from redwood-v2 to redwood-v1 for request <id> at <ts>. Attach sample vector, prompt, and index config."

support-bot: Note posted to #support: auto-alert if >10 fallback events per hour.

lee: Nice work. Tara please open PR and include smoke-test GH action. I'll review.
